newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settles lower, technical outlook poor.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settles lower, technical outlook poor.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures slid further on Thursday as the market's technical outlook took a further turn for the worse, traders said.
Despite a dearth of fresh fundamental news, the market closed at its lowest level since November 1995.
"It looks bad on the charts," a floor source said. "It looks like the funds are starting to get short here or else they are still kicking out the longs."
November FCOJ settled 2.10 cents weaker at 103.10 cents per pound, traded 106.40 to 103.00 cents. Spot September ended 1.60 cents down at 113.00 cents.
"I suggest cash prices are going to weaken because futures prices normally sell at a premium to cash," Bernard Savaiko of PaineWebber said.
Traders pegged the next level of support at 100 to 102 cents basis November, but Savaiko said that on the long-term charts November may well trade below 100 cents.
